signal: Sage raised a $65M Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, bringing total capital to $124M, and is expanding its Sage Detect AI monitoring and EHR partnerships across senior living

email.body1:
Bryant, saw Sage close its $65M Series C with Goldman Sachs and expand Sage Detect and your EHR partnerships.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market senior living operators in play than a sales team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sage off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bryant, quick follow-up for Sage.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sage needs across senior living accounts this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bryant, last bit of proof for Sage.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sage's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bryant, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the post-Series-C stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a senior living motion? I'll tailor it to Sage either way.
